parole.significato: to grab something greedily or repeatedly; to hog (to greedily take more than one's share)
parole.testo: From Proto-Finnic *ahmidak (“to wolf down, to eat quickly; to hog, to hoard”), from *ahma (“glutton; wolverine”) + *-idak. Proto-Finnic *ahma comes from earlier *ašma, probably borrowed from Proto-Indo-Iranian *Haćman-. Equivalent to ahm + -ma. Cognate with Finnish ahmia, Ingrian ahmia, Livvi ahmie,

parole.significato: greedy (having greed; consumed by selfish desires)
parole.testo: Inherited from Proto-Finnic *ahnëh, from *ahnas (“greedy, voracious; eager”) + *-ëh. Proto-Finnic *ahnas is borrowed from Proto-Indo-Iranian *(H)aćHnas. Cognate with Finnish ahne, Votic ahnõ.
From Proto-Finnic *erei, from Proto-Indo-Iranian *er-. Cognate with Finnish eri and Votic eri. Related to eraldi, era, ära (“away”), iseäranis, iseäralik.
